<!-- Fonts & icons (CDN). Site still works with system fonts if offline. -->
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">

<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.5.1/css/all.min.css" crossorigin="anonymous">

<style>
/* ============ 1. DESIGN TOKENS ============ */
:root{
  --navy-900:#071428;
  --navy-800:#0b1f3a;
  --navy-700:#12305a;
  --navy-600:#1b4478;
  --slate-700:#334155;
  --slate-500:#64748b;
  --slate-300:#cbd5e1;
  --slate-200:#e2e8f0;
  --slate-100:#f1f5f9;
  --paper:#f8fafc;
  --white:#ffffff;
  --teal:#14b8a6;
  --teal-dark:#0f8f84;
  --gold:#c9a24b;
  --gold-soft:#f3e7c6;
  --radius:18px;
  --shadow-sm:0 2px 8px rgba(11,31,58,.06);
  --shadow-md:0 12px 32px rgba(11,31,58,.10);
  --shadow-lg:0 24px 60px rgba(11,31,58,.18);
  --font-display:'Fraunces', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif;
  --font-body:'Manrope', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;
  --maxw:1180px;
}

/* ============ 2. RESET & BASE ============ */
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;scroll-padding-top:84px}
body{margin:0;font-family:var(--font-body);color:var(--slate-700);background:var(--paper);line-height:1.65;font-size:16px;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
img{max-width:100%;display:block}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
ul{margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none}
h1,h2,h3,h4{font-family:var(--font-display);color:var(--navy-800);margin:0;line-height:1.15;letter-spacing:-.01em}
p{margin:0}
.container{width:min(var(--maxw),100% - 40px);margin-inline:auto}
section{padding:96px 0;position:relative}
.sr-only{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0 0 0 0);white-space:nowrap}
:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--teal);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:6px}

/* Section headings */
.eyebrow{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-weight:700;font-size:.78rem;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--teal-dark);margin-bottom:14px}
.eyebrow::before{content:"";width:28px;height:2px;background:var(--gold)}
.section-title{font-size:clamp(2rem,4vw,2.9rem);margin-bottom:14px}
.section-lead{max-width:640px;color:var(--slate-500);font-size:1.05rem}
.section-head{margin-bottom:56px}
.section-head.center{text-align:center}
.section-head.center .section-lead{margin-inline:auto}
.section-head.center .eyebrow::after{content:"";width:28px;height:2px;background:var(--gold)}

/* Buttons */
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:14px 26px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:700;font-size:.95rem;border:2px solid transparent;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .25s ease, box-shadow .25s ease, background .25s ease, color .25s ease}
.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-3px)}
.btn-primary{background:var(--gold);color:var(--navy-900);box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(201,162,75,.35)}
.btn-primary:hover{box-shadow:0 16px 32px rgba(201,162,75,.5);background:#d8b25a}
.btn-ghost{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.35);color:var(--white)}
.btn-ghost:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);border-color:var(--white)}

/* Reveal-on-scroll */
.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(28px);transition:opacity .8s ease, transform .8s ease}
.reveal.in{opacity:1;transform:none}
.reveal[data-delay="1"]{transition-delay:.1s}.reveal[data-delay="2"]{transition-delay:.2s}.reveal[data-delay="3"]{transition-delay:.3s}

/* ============ 3. NAVIGATION ============ */
.nav{position:fixed;inset:0 0 auto 0;z-index:100;transition:background .3s ease, box-shadow .3s ease, padding .3s ease;padding:18px 0}
.nav.scrolled{background:rgba(7,20,40,.92);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);box-shadow:0 6px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.2);padding:10px 0}
.nav .container{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;color:var(--white);font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:600;font-size:1.15rem}
.brand .mark{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:12px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--gold),#e6c97a);color:var(--navy-900);display:grid;place-items:center;font-weight:700;font-size:1rem}
.menu{display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center}
.menu a{color:rgba(255,255,255,.82);font-weight:600;font-size:.88rem;padding:8px 13px;border-radius:999px;transition:color .2s, background .2s}
.menu a:hover,.menu a.active{color:var(--white);background:rgba(255,255,255,.1)}
.menu a.cta{background:var(--gold);color:var(--navy-900)}
.menu a.cta:hover{background:#d8b25a}
.burger{display:none;background:none;border:0;color:var(--white);font-size:1.5rem;cursor:pointer;padding:6px}

/* ============ 4. HERO ============ */
.hero{min-height:100vh;display:flex;align-items:center;padding:140px 0 90px;color:var(--white);overflow:hidden;
  background:
    radial-gradient(900px 500px at 85% 15%, rgba(20,184,166,.20), transparent 60%),
    radial-gradient(700px 500px at 0% 100%, rgba(201,162,75,.14), transparent 60%),
    linear-gradient(160deg,var(--navy-900) 0%,var(--navy-800) 55%,var(--navy-700) 100%)}
.hero::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background-image:linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.04) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.04) 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:56px 56px;mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse at 70% 40%,#000 10%,transparent 70%);-webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse at 70% 40%,#000 10%,transparent 70%)}
.hero-grid{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.25fr .85fr;gap:60px;align-items:center}
.hero .badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:8px 16px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);font-size:.82rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.04em;margin-bottom:26px}
.hero .badge i{color:var(--gold)}
.hero h1{color:var(--white);font-size:clamp(2.6rem,6.2vw,4.8rem);margin-bottom:18px}
.hero h1 span{color:var(--gold);font-style:italic}
.hero .role{font-size:clamp(1.05rem,2vw,1.3rem);font-weight:600;color:#dbe7f7;max-width:560px}
.hero .role small{display:block;font-weight:500;color:#9fb4d1;font-size:.95rem;margin-top:6px}
.hero .tagline{margin-top:22px;max-width:540px;color:#b7c7de}
.hero-cta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px;margin-top:34px}
.contact-chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;margin-top:38px}
.chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:10px 16px;border-radius:12px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);font-size:.88rem;color:#e6eefb;transition:background .25s, transform .25s, border-color .25s}
.chip i{color:var(--teal);width:16px;text-align:center}
a.chip:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.14);transform:translateY(-3px);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.3)}

.portrait{position:relative;justify-self:center;width:min(380px,82%)}
.portrait::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-18px;border-radius:200px 200px 28px 28px;border:2px solid var(--gold);opacity:.7;transform:translate(14px,14px)}
.portrait .frame{position:relative;border-radius:200px 200px 24px 24px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg);background:#fff;aspect-ratio:4/5}
.portrait img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:50% 18%}
.float-card{position:absolute;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;background:var(--white);color:var(--navy-800);padding:12px 18px;border-radius:14px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-md);font-weight:700;font-size:.85rem;animation:float 5s ease-in-out infinite}
.float-card i{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:10px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:var(--gold-soft);color:#8a6a1c}
.float-card small{display:block;font-weight:500;color:var(--slate-500);font-size:.74rem}
.float-card.a{left:-46px;bottom:70px}
.float-card.b{right:-30px;top:60px;animation-delay:-2.2s}
.float-card.b i{background:#d9f5f1;color:var(--teal-dark)}
@keyframes float{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-10px)}}

.scroll-hint{position:absolute;bottom:26px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);color:rgba(255,255,255,.55);font-size:1.2rem;animation:bounce 2s infinite}
@keyframes bounce{0%,100%{transform:translate(-50%,0)}50%{transform:translate(-50%,8px)}}

/* ============ 5. STATS STRIP ============ */
.stats{padding:0;margin-top:-56px;position:relative;z-index:5}
.stats-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);background:var(--white);border-radius:var(--radius);box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg);overflow:hidden}
.stat{padding:32px 24px;text-align:center;border-right:1px solid var(--slate-200)}
.stat:last-child{border-right:0}
.stat .num{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:clamp(2rem,3.6vw,2.9rem);font-weight:700;color:var(--navy-800)}
.stat .num sup{font-size:.5em;color:var(--gold);margin-left:2px;vertical-align:super}
.stat .lbl{font-size:.86rem;color:var(--slate-500);font-weight:600;margin-top:4px}

/* ============ 6. ABOUT / PROFILE ============ */
.about-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr .9fr;gap:56px;align-items:start}
.about-text p{font-size:1.06rem;margin-bottom:18px}
.about-text p strong{color:var(--navy-800)}
.mini-facts{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:14px;margin-top:26px}
.mini-facts div{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;padding:16px;background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--slate-200);border-radius:14px}
.mini-facts i{color:var(--teal-dark);margin-top:4px}
.mini-facts b{display:block;color:var(--navy-800);font-size:.92rem}
.mini-facts span{font-size:.84rem;color:var(--slate-500)}
.expertise{background:var(--white);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:34px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-md);border:1px solid var(--slate-200)}
.expertise h3{font-size:1.35rem;margin-bottom:22px}
.tags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}
.tag{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:10px 15px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--slate-100);color:var(--navy-700);font-weight:600;font-size:.88rem;transition:all .25s ease;border:1px solid transparent}
.tag i{color:var(--teal-dark);font-size:.85rem}
.tag:hover{background:var(--navy-800);color:var(--white);transform:translateY(-3px)}
.tag:hover i{color:var(--gold)}

/* ============ 7. AI SECTION ============ */
.ai{background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--navy-900),var(--navy-800));color:#c4d3ea;overflow:hidden}
.ai::before{content:"";position:absolute;width:520px;height:520px;right:-160px;top:-160px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(20,184,166,.22),transparent 70%)}
.ai .section-title{color:var(--white)}
.ai .section-lead{color:#9fb4d1}
.ai .eyebrow{color:var(--teal)}
.ai-grid{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:20px}
.ai-card{padding:28px 24px;border-radius:var(--radius);background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);transition:transform .3s, background .3s, border-color .3s}
.ai-card:hover{transform:translateY(-8px);background:rgba(255,255,255,.09);border-color:rgba(201,162,75,.5)}
.ai-card .ico{width:50px;height:50px;border-radius:14px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:rgba(20,184,166,.16);color:var(--teal);font-size:1.25rem;margin-bottom:18px}
.ai-card h3{color:var(--white);font-size:1.12rem;margin-bottom:10px;font-family:var(--font-body);font-weight:700}
.ai-card p{font-size:.92rem;line-height:1.6}
.ai-tools{position:relative;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;justify-content:center;margin-top:40px}
.ai-tools span{padding:9px 18px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid rgba(201,162,75,.5);color:var(--gold-soft);font-weight:700;font-size:.85rem;letter-spacing:.03em}

/* ============ 8. TIMELINE (experience + education) ============ */
.timeline{position:relative;padding-left:44px}
.timeline::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:11px;top:6px;bottom:6px;width:2px;background:linear-gradient(var(--gold),var(--slate-300))}
.t-item{position:relative;margin-bottom:34px}
.t-item:last-child{margin-bottom:0}
.t-item::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:-44px;top:26px;width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--white);border:4px solid var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 0 6px rgba(201,162,75,.18)}
.t-card{background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--slate-200);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:32px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);transition:transform .3s, box-shadow .3s}
.t-card:hover{transform:translateY(-6px);box-shadow:var(--shadow-md)}
.t-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:flex-start;margin-bottom:6px}
.t-card h3{font-size:1.4rem}
.date-pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:6px 14px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--gold-soft);color:#7a5a12;font-weight:700;font-size:.8rem;white-space:nowrap}
.org{color:var(--teal-dark);font-weight:700;margin-top:4px}
.loc{color:var(--slate-500);font-size:.88rem;margin-top:2px}
.loc i{margin-right:6px}
.t-cols{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:26px;margin-top:26px;padding-top:24px;border-top:1px dashed var(--slate-300)}
.t-cols h4{font-family:var(--font-body);font-size:.78rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--navy-700);margin-bottom:14px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.t-cols h4 i{color:var(--gold)}
.ticks li{position:relative;padding-left:24px;margin-bottom:10px;font-size:.92rem;line-height:1.55}
.ticks li::before{content:"\f00c";font-family:"Font Awesome 6 Free";font-weight:900;position:absolute;left:0;top:1px;color:var(--teal);font-size:.72rem}
.ticks.single{margin-top:20px}
.ticks.single li{font-size:.98rem}

/* ============ 9. PROJECTS ============ */
.projects{background:var(--white)}
.proj-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:24px}
.proj{position:relative;background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--slate-200);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:30px 26px 26px;overflow:hidden;transition:transform .3s, box-shadow .3s, border-color .3s;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.proj::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:0;height:4px;width:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--gold),var(--teal));transition:width .4s ease}
.proj:hover{transform:translateY(-8px);box-shadow:var(--shadow-md);border-color:transparent;background:var(--white)}
.proj:hover::after{width:100%}
.proj .ico{width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:14px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:1.3rem;background:var(--navy-800);color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:18px;transition:transform .3s}
.proj:hover .ico{transform:rotate(-8deg) scale(1.08)}
.proj .cat{font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:800;color:var(--teal-dark);margin-bottom:8px}
.proj h3{font-size:1.15rem;margin-bottom:10px;font-family:var(--font-body);font-weight:800;line-height:1.3}
.proj p{font-size:.92rem;color:var(--slate-500);flex:1}
.metric{margin-top:18px;display:inline-flex;align-items:baseline;gap:8px;padding:8px 14px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--gold-soft);color:#6f5210;font-weight:800;font-size:.82rem;align-self:flex-start}
.metric b{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:1.25rem;color:#4e3a08}
.proj.feature{background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--navy-800),var(--navy-700));border:0}
.proj.feature h3{color:var(--white)}
.proj.feature p{color:#b9c9e2}
.proj.feature .ico{background:rgba(255,255,255,.1)}
.proj.feature .cat{color:var(--teal)}
.proj.feature:hover{background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--navy-800),var(--navy-700))}

/* ============ 10. EDUCATION ============ */
.edu-wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:0;max-width:860px;margin-inline:auto}
.edu .t-card{padding:24px 28px}
.edu .t-card h3{font-size:1.2rem}
.edu .t-top{align-items:center;margin-bottom:0}
.degree-icon{display:inline-grid;place-items:center;width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--navy-800);color:var(--gold);margin-right:12px;font-size:.9rem;vertical-align:middle}

/* ============ 11. CERTIFICATIONS ============ */
.certs{background:var(--white)}
.cert-hero{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr auto;gap:28px;align-items:center;padding:34px 38px;border-radius:var(--radius);background:linear-gradient(120deg,var(--navy-900),var(--navy-700));color:#c4d3ea;margin-bottom:34px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-md);position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.cert-hero::after{content:"";position:absolute;right:-60px;top:-60px;width:240px;height:240px;border-radius:50%;border:30px solid rgba(201,162,75,.12)}
.cert-hero .seal{width:84px;height:84px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:2rem;color:var(--navy-900);background:radial-gradient(circle at 30% 30%,#f2dc9a,var(--gold));box-shadow:0 0 0 8px rgba(201,162,75,.2)}
.cert-hero h3{color:var(--white);font-size:1.6rem;margin-bottom:4px}
.cert-hero p{color:#9fb4d1}
.cert-hero .pill{padding:8px 16px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);color:var(--gold-soft);font-weight:700;font-size:.82rem;position:relative;z-index:1}
.cert-groups{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:24px}
.cert-group{border:1px solid var(--slate-200);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:28px;background:var(--paper);transition:box-shadow .3s, transform .3s}
.cert-group:hover{box-shadow:var(--shadow-md);transform:translateY(-4px)}
.cert-group h3{font-family:var(--font-body);font-size:.95rem;font-weight:800;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-bottom:18px;color:var(--navy-800)}
.cert-group h3 i{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:10px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:var(--navy-800);color:var(--gold);font-size:.95rem}
.cert-list li{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;padding:11px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--slate-200);font-size:.92rem}
.cert-list li:first-child{border-top:0;padding-top:0}
.cert-list li i{color:var(--teal);margin-top:5px;font-size:.8rem}
.cert-list b{color:var(--navy-800);display:block;font-weight:700;line-height:1.35}
.cert-list span{color:var(--slate-500);font-size:.82rem}

/* ============ 12. SKILLS ============ */
.skills-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr .9fr;gap:34px}
.panel{background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--slate-200);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:34px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm)}
.panel h3{font-size:1.35rem;margin-bottom:26px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}
.panel h3 i{color:var(--gold)}
.skill{margin-bottom:22px}
.skill-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-weight:700;font-size:.92rem;color:var(--navy-800);margin-bottom:8px}
.skill-top span:first-child i{width:24px;color:var(--teal-dark)}
.skill-top em{font-style:normal;color:var(--slate-500);font-weight:600;font-size:.8rem}
.bar{height:9px;border-radius:99px;background:var(--slate-100);overflow:hidden}
.bar i{display:block;height:100%;width:0;border-radius:99px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--teal),var(--gold));transition:width 1.4s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}
.soft{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:12px;margin-bottom:34px}
.soft div{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:14px;border-radius:14px;background:var(--slate-100);font-weight:600;font-size:.9rem;color:var(--navy-800);transition:transform .25s, background .25s}
.soft div:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);background:var(--gold-soft)}
.soft i{color:var(--teal-dark);width:20px;text-align:center}
.lang{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:12px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--slate-200);font-weight:600;color:var(--navy-800);font-size:.92rem}
.lang:first-of-type{border-top:0}
.dots{display:flex;gap:5px}
.dots i{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--slate-300)}
.dots i.on{background:var(--gold)}
.lang small{display:block;color:var(--slate-500);font-weight:500;font-size:.78rem}

/* ============ 13. GALLERY ============ */
.gallery{background:var(--navy-900);color:#c4d3ea}
.gallery .section-title{color:var(--white)}
.gallery .section-lead{color:#9fb4d1}
.gallery .eyebrow{color:var(--teal)}
.masonry{columns:3;column-gap:20px}
.shot{position:relative;display:block;width:100%;break-inside:avoid;margin:0 0 20px;border:0;padding:0;border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;cursor:zoom-in;background:var(--navy-700);text-align:left;font:inherit}
.shot img{width:100%;height:auto;transition:transform .7s ease, filter .4s}
.shot:hover img{transform:scale(1.06);filter:brightness(.7)}
.shot figcaption,.shot .cap{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;padding:44px 18px 16px;background:linear-gradient(transparent,rgba(7,20,40,.92));color:var(--white);transform:translateY(12px);opacity:0;transition:all .35s ease}
.shot:hover .cap,.shot:focus-visible .cap{transform:none;opacity:1}
.cap b{display:block;font-size:.95rem;font-family:var(--font-body)}
.cap span{font-size:.78rem;color:#b7c7de}
.shot .award-tag{position:absolute;top:14px;left:14px;display:inline-flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;padding:6px 12px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--gold);color:var(--navy-900);font-weight:800;font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.04em}
.gallery-note{margin-top:14px;text-align:center;font-size:.85rem;color:#7f95b6}

/* Lightbox */
.lightbox{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:300;background:rgba(4,10,22,.94);display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:30px;flex-direction:column;gap:16px}
.lightbox.open{display:flex;animation:fade .25s ease}
.lightbox img{max-height:80vh;max-width:min(1100px,94vw);border-radius:12px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg);object-fit:contain}
.lightbox p{color:#d9e4f5;font-weight:600;text-align:center}
.lb-btn{position:absolute;background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);border:0;color:#fff;width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:50%;font-size:1.1rem;cursor:pointer;transition:background .2s}
.lb-btn:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.25)}
.lb-close{top:20px;right:20px}.lb-prev{left:20px;top:50%}.lb-next{right:20px;top:50%}
@keyframes fade{from{opacity:0}to{opacity:1}}

/* ============ 14. CONTACT ============ */
.contact{background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--navy-800),var(--navy-900));color:#c4d3ea;overflow:hidden}
.contact::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:-180px;bottom:-180px;width:520px;height:520px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(201,162,75,.18),transparent 70%)}
.contact .section-title{color:var(--white)}
.contact .section-lead{color:#9fb4d1}
.contact .eyebrow{color:var(--teal)}
.contact-grid{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr .8fr;gap:48px;align-items:center}
.contact-list{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:16px;margin-top:34px}
.c-item{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:center;padding:18px;border-radius:16px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);transition:transform .3s, background .3s, border-color .3s;min-width:0}
a.c-item:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);border-color:rgba(201,162,75,.6)}
.c-item .ico{flex:none;width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:13px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:rgba(201,162,75,.16);color:var(--gold);font-size:1.1rem}
.c-item small{display:block;color:#8ea5c6;font-size:.74rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.1em;font-weight:700}
.c-item span{color:var(--white);font-weight:600;font-size:.94rem;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.c-item.wide{grid-column:1/-1}
.qr-card{background:var(--white);border-radius:24px;padding:30px;text-align:center;box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg);max-width:340px;margin-inline:auto;transition:transform .4s}
.qr-card:hover{transform:rotate(-1.5deg) translateY(-6px)}
.qr-card h3{font-size:1.3rem;margin-bottom:6px}
.qr-card p{color:var(--slate-500);font-size:.88rem;margin-bottom:18px}
.qr-box{border:2px dashed var(--gold);border-radius:16px;padding:14px;background:#fff}
.qr-box img{width:100%;height:auto;aspect-ratio:1/1;object-fit:contain;image-rendering:pixelated}
.qr-card .scan{margin-top:16px;font-weight:800;font-size:.8rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--teal-dark)}

/* ============ 15. FOOTER ============ */
footer{background:#040b18;color:#7f95b6;padding:30px 0;font-size:.88rem}
footer .container{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center}
footer a{color:#b7c7de;margin-left:16px;transition:color .2s}
footer a:hover{color:var(--gold)}
.to-top{position:fixed;right:22px;bottom:22px;width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:50%;border:0;background:var(--gold);color:var(--navy-900);font-size:1.05rem;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.3);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transform:translateY(12px);transition:all .3s;z-index:90}
.to-top.show{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto;transform:none}

/* ============ 16. RESPONSIVE ============ */
@media (max-width:1040px){
  .ai-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
  .proj-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
  .t-cols{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
  .t-cols>div:last-child{grid-column:1/-1}
  .masonry{columns:2}
}
@media (max-width:900px){
  section{padding:76px 0}
  .burger{display:block}
  .menu{position:fixed;inset:0 0 0 auto;width:min(320px,84vw);background:var(--navy-900);flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;padding:90px 22px 30px;gap:6px;transform:translateX(100%);transition:transform .35s ease;box-shadow:-20px 0 50px rgba(0,0,0,.4)}
  .menu.open{transform:none}
  .menu a{padding:14px 16px;font-size:1rem}
  .hero{padding-top:120px}
  .hero-grid,.about-grid,.skills-grid,.contact-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .hero-grid{gap:56px}
  .portrait{order:-1;width:min(300px,76%)}
  .float-card.a{left:-20px}.float-card.b{right:-14px}
  .stats-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
  .stat:nth-child(2){border-right:0}
  .stat:nth-child(-n+2){border-bottom:1px solid var(--slate-200)}
  .cert-hero{grid-template-columns:1fr;text-align:center;justify-items:center}
  .cert-groups{grid-template-columns:1fr}
}
@media (max-width:640px){
  .container{width:calc(100% - 32px)}
  .ai-grid,.proj-grid,.t-cols,.contact-list,.mini-facts,.soft{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .masonry{columns:1}
  .t-card{padding:24px 20px}
  .timeline{padding-left:34px}
  .t-item::before{left:-34px;width:20px;height:20px;top:24px}
  .timeline::before{left:9px}
  .hero-cta .btn{width:100%;justify-content:center}
  .float-card{display:none}
  .panel{padding:26px 20px}
  .shot .cap{opacity:1;transform:none}
  footer .container{flex-direction:column;text-align:center}
  footer a{margin:0 8px}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  *{animation:none!important;transition:none!important;scroll-behavior:auto!important}
  .reveal{opacity:1;transform:none}
}
@media print{
  .nav,.to-top,.scroll-hint,.lightbox{display:none!important}
  .reveal{opacity:1!important;transform:none!important}
  section{padding:30px 0}
}
</style>
</head>

<button class="to-top" id="toTop" aria-label="Back to top"><i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up"></i></button>

<!-- Lightbox -->
<div class="lightbox" id="lightbox" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Photo viewer">
  <button class="lb-btn lb-close" id="lbClose" aria-label="Close"><i class="fa-solid fa-xmark"></i></button>
  <button class="lb-btn lb-prev" id="lbPrev" aria-label="Previous photo"><i class="fa-solid fa-chevron-left"></i></button>
  <img id="lbImg" src="" alt="">
  <p id="lbCap"></p>
  <button class="lb-btn lb-next" id="lbNext" aria-label="Next photo"><i class="fa-solid fa-chevron-right"></i></button>
</div>

<script>
/* ===== Minimal JS: nav, reveal, counters, skill bars, lightbox ===== */
(function(){
  var $=function(s,c){return (c||document).querySelector(s)}, $$=function(s,c){return Array.prototype.slice.call((c||document).querySelectorAll(s))};

  /* Footer year */
  $('#year').textContent=new Date().getFullYear();

  /* Sticky nav + back-to-top */
  var nav=$('#nav'), toTop=$('#toTop');
  function onScroll(){
    var y=window.scrollY;
    nav.classList.toggle('scrolled',y>40);
    toTop.classList.toggle('show',y>600);
  }
  window.addEventListener('scroll',onScroll,{passive:true}); onScroll();
  toTop.addEventListener('click',function(){window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'})});

  /* Mobile menu */
  var burger=$('#burger'), menu=$('#menu');
  function setMenu(open){
    menu.classList.toggle('open',open);
    burger.setAttribute('aria-expanded',open);
    burger.firstElementChild.className=open?'fa-solid fa-xmark':'fa-solid fa-bars';
  }
  burger.addEventListener('click',function(){setMenu(!menu.classList.contains('open'))});
  $$('#menu a').forEach(function(a){a.addEventListener('click',function(){setMenu(false)})});

  /* Active link highlighting */
  var links=$$('#menu a:not(.cta)');
  var spy=new IntersectionObserver(function(es){
    es.forEach(function(e){
      if(e.isIntersecting){
        links.forEach(function(l){l.classList.toggle('active',l.getAttribute('href')==='#'+e.target.id)});
      }
    });
  },{rootMargin:'-45% 0px -50% 0px'});
  links.forEach(function(l){var s=$(l.getAttribute('href')); if(s) spy.observe(s)});

  /* Reveal on scroll */
  var reduce=window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  var revealEls=$$('.reveal');
  if('IntersectionObserver' in window && !reduce){
    var ro=new IntersectionObserver(function(es){
      es.forEach(function(e){ if(e.isIntersecting){ e.target.classList.add('in'); ro.unobserve(e.target);} });
    },{threshold:.12});
    revealEls.forEach(function(el){ro.observe(el)});
  } else { revealEls.forEach(function(el){el.classList.add('in')}); }

  /* Count-up numbers */
  function count(el){
    var end=parseFloat(el.dataset.count), dec=parseInt(el.dataset.decimals||0,10), t0=null, dur=1600;
    if(reduce){el.textContent=end.toFixed(dec);return}
    function step(t){ if(!t0)t0=t; var p=Math.min((t-t0)/dur,1), v=end*(1-Math.pow(1-p,3)); el.textContent=v.toFixed(dec); if(p<1)requestAnimationFrame(step) }
    requestAnimationFrame(step);
  }
  var co=new IntersectionObserver(function(es){es.forEach(function(e){if(e.isIntersecting){count(e.target);co.unobserve(e.target)}})},{threshold:.6});
  $$('[data-count]').forEach(function(el){co.observe(el)});

  /* Skill bars */
  var bo=new IntersectionObserver(function(es){es.forEach(function(e){if(e.isIntersecting){e.target.style.width=e.target.dataset.w+'%';bo.unobserve(e.target)}})},{threshold:.4});
  $$('.bar i').forEach(function(b){bo.observe(b)});

  /* Lightbox */
  var shots=$$('.shot'), lb=$('#lightbox'), lbImg=$('#lbImg'), lbCap=$('#lbCap'), idx=0, lastFocus=null;
  function show(i){
    idx=(i+shots.length)%shots.length;
    var s=shots[idx], im=$('img',s), c=$('.cap',s);
    lbImg.src=im.src; lbImg.alt=im.alt; lbCap.textContent=c?($('b',c).textContent+' — '+$('span',c).textContent):'';
  }
  function open(i){lastFocus=document.activeElement; show(i); lb.classList.add('open'); document.body.style.overflow='hidden'; $('#lbClose').focus()}
  function close(){lb.classList.remove('open'); document.body.style.overflow=''; if(lastFocus)lastFocus.focus()}
  shots.forEach(function(s,i){s.addEventListener('click',function(){open(i)})});
  $('#lbClose').addEventListener('click',close);
  $('#lbPrev').addEventListener('click',function(){show(idx-1)});
  $('#lbNext').addEventListener('click',function(){show(idx+1)});
  lb.addEventListener('click',function(e){if(e.target===lb)close()});
  document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
    if(!lb.classList.contains('open'))return;
    if(e.key==='Escape')close(); if(e.key==='ArrowLeft')show(idx-1); if(e.key==='ArrowRight')show(idx+1);
  });
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
